name: Observed FSMO role changes
description: Holder transitions observed within the selected range, independently per reporting DC/domain/role. The first observation is a baseline, empty holders are not changes. Requires ADConfig_CL.Computer; reports are not mixed across DCs.
kql:
ADConfig_CL
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where isnotempty(DNSRoot)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, DNSRoot, Timestamp = TimeGenerated
| extend Roles = bag_pack('PDCEmulator', PDCEmulator, 'RIDMaster', RIDMaster, 'InfrastructureMaster', InfrastructureMaster, 'SchemaMaster', SchemaMaster, 'DomainNamingMaster', DomainNamingMaster)
| mv-expand Role = bag_keys(Roles) to typeof(string)
| extend NewHolder = tolower(trim(' ', tostring(Roles[Role])))
| sort by Computer asc, DNSRoot asc, Role asc, Timestamp asc
| serialize OldHolder = prev(NewHolder), PreviousComputer = prev(Computer), PreviousDomain = prev(DNSRoot), PreviousRole = prev(Role)
| where Computer == PreviousComputer and DNSRoot == PreviousDomain and Role == PreviousRole
| where isnotempty(OldHolder) and isnotempty(NewHolder) and OldHolder != NewHolder
| project Timestamp, Computer, DNSRoot, Role, OldHolder, NewHolder
| order by Timestamp desc
